title: creepers evrywhere
description: a mod thad hides creeper faces in 100 difrend blocks similar to how Mickey Mouse ears are hidden throughout Disneyland."
body:
Hi, I'm Matsdcx!

I created this texture pack featuring 100 hidden creepers scattered across random blocks. Good luck finding them all!

A Note for Streamers & Content Creators: If you use this texture pack for TikTok streams or other online content, please include a link to this project in your description. It would also be awesome if you could include a link to my YouTube channel. Thanks for the support!
